---
code: iam.session.limit_reached
status: 500
title: Maximum concurrent sessions reached
summary: |
  An unexpected error occurred while the server processed the request.
client_action: |
  Retry a limited number of times with backoff. If it persists, report the `request_id` to the operations team.
operator_action: |
  Correlate `request_id` and `trace_id` in the service logs for the failing handler, and check recent deployments and migrations.
